text.tspan: A VP flags a quality-of-hire problem in Services. The CHRO checks it, hands it off, and the HR BP validates it and builds the plan.
A VP reports poor-quality new hires
The Services VP hears from the team that new hires
leave fast and underperform. I need to see what’s
happening; we just bought People Analytics.
I want to get ahead of this. I open Workday, go to People
Analytics and ask: “What is the quality of hire for the
No company-wide issue, hand it to off
I scan the KPIs I care about (Quality of Hire is visible) and
the topic areas. It isn’t company-wide, so I delegate to
Sarah, the HR BP for Services.
Hand-off: CHRO → Sarah (HR BP, Services) — or an Analyst where there’s no HRBP model
Services is one of my three partner orgs. I need to
validate the issue, find where it is, and build an action
plan with the VP Recruiting that my CHRO can share.
I open People Analytics and ask: “What is the quality of
I scan the same KPIs. By default I see a wide slice of the
company — I want the Services organization specifically.

What are the KPIs and topic areas? How did they get
